title: Cosmic Chess Gambit
description: A surreal scene shows a stone chessboard in the foreground with ornate silver and black pieces, some toppled, and lit candles. A person's arm in a blue and gold patterned sleeve reaches from the right, placing a glowing blue orb on the board. Behind it, vibrant pink and yellow peonies emerge from cracked stone, with swirling red and orange fiery energy, floating transparent text shards, and a dark purple dramatic sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a cracked stone chess table with ornate metallic pieces and lit candles, a hand in ornate blue and gold sleeves placing a glowing blue orb onto the board, vibrant pink and yellow peonies growing from the stone, swirling red fiery energy in the background, floating transparent shards with text, dramatic dark purple sky with crescent moons, epic and mysterious atmosphere
